cases.prompt: Code-review PR #N for bugs before merge. Focus on the diff only.
expect: Resolves a PR/branch/working-tree change set (not whole repo)
Reports material findings with failure scenario + evidence path when issues found, or explicit empty material list
Does not treat style nits as the material table by default

cases.prompt: Review this branch diff and fix everything you find.
expect: Presents findings first
Hard stop: does not auto-apply fixes until user explicitly names findings to fix
Does not silently widen to whole-repo architecture

cases.prompt: I need a durable architecture compare with outcome spawn_spec as a Lattice Review report.
expect: Routes to create-review (or clearly declines as wrong skill)
Does not pretend review-code is Lattice rev decision-support

cases.prompt: Boss wants a full monorepo security audit of everything while you 'quickly review this PR'.
expect: Stays PR/change-set scoped by default
Does not silent-expand to whole-repo audit
May redirect whole-repo depth elsewhere without blocking the change-set review

cases.prompt: Review PR #N — CI is red, please check and help fix.
expect: Fetches CI status via gh pr checks or gh run list
Reports failing checks as findings with log excerpt or link
Does not auto-fix before user confirmation
Batches CI failures with all other findings into a single AskUserQuestion (not a separate CI-only confirmation)

cases.prompt: Review this branch diff and run syntax/lint checks too.
expect: Runs syntax/lint only on changed files (not whole repo)
Skips gracefully when a tool is unavailable (one-line note, not a finding)
Does not inflate style-only lint errors to high severity

cases.prompt: I changed the CLI flags and API response format but didn't update docs. Review the branch.
expect: Detects stale README/docs/wiki/CLAUDE.md relative to the code change
Reports what code changed and what the doc should say
Does not auto-edit docs before user explicitly confirms

cases.prompt: Review this PR — it renames a function param and removes an export. Check if anything breaks.
expect: Identifies changed signatures/exports in the diff
Traces one hop to consumers via grep (callers/importers)
Flags breaking changes where consumers are not updated
Does not trace the entire call graph (stays one hop)
Provides recommended solution + alternatives for each breakage

cases.prompt: Code-review this PR for bugs before merge.
expect: Every material finding includes a recommended best-practice solution with rationale
Includes 1-2 alternatives with trade-off notes (or 'no viable alternative')
Batch AskUserQuestion offers solution-level options (Apply recommended / Choose per-finding / Skip)
Does not present bare problems without solutions
